text:
maria_support: FYI customer reported huge spike in embeddings 'units' on the console, says they're being billed way higher. They pasted a screenshot that labels the metric as 'embedding_units (vectors)' but numbers line up with token counts.
vikram_eng-ml: ack, can you paste the raw payload they used and any request ids?
maria_support: forwarding their repro snippet (they used our hosted API):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'X-Request-ID: acme-req-2026-04-12-01' \n  -d '{"model":"rw-embed-768-v1","input":["doc1 text...","doc2 text..."]}'
```
maria_support: customer says panel shows 4 vectors but billing shows 1,200 embedding_units for same minute (seems tokens). They suspect double-counting during retries.
vikram_eng-ml: can you also paste the exact timestamps from their screenshot? Need to correlate with ingestion events.
maria_support: screenshot timestamps: 2026-04-12T01:22:00Z -> 01:26:00Z. I pulled the raw events from support logs and attached a trimmed list: request_id acme-req-2026-04-12-01 appears 3 times, each with event_type: embeddings.generate and metrics.unit_count values: 400, 400, 400.
olivia_billing: that would explain ~1200 units. We should treat as high priority if customer is being billed.
sam_product: is this live for multiple customers or isolated? any recent deploys to the metrics pipeline?
vikram_eng-ml: I suspect the metrics service changed the dedupe key in the last deploy. There was a PR converting request_id -> request_uuid to support v2 tracing; if both fields exist we may insert duplicate rows. I'll check the aggregator job.
metrics-bot: [logs] metrics-aggregator/weekly-rollup job started at 2026-04-12T01:20:00Z, partition=us-west-2, input=stream-embeddings-events.
vikram_eng-ml: running quick ClickHouse query to compare counts (distinct request_id vs sum unit_count)
```sql
SELECT toDate(event_time) as d, count() as raw_events, uniqExact(request_id) as distinct_requests, sum(unit_count) as total_units
FROM embeddings_events
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-04-12 01:20:00' AND '2026-04-12 01:30:00'
GROUP BY d
```
vikram_eng-ml: results show raw_events=9, distinct_requests=3, total_units=3600. distinct_requests * expected_per_request(400) = 1200, but total_units=3600. So units are being summed per event with duplicates.
maria_support: customer said they observed API returning 200 OK once per call, no retries visible on their side. Could be internal replay.
vikram_eng-ml: checking stream consumer offsets and retry logs. I see the embeddings consumer crashed briefly at 01:21:30 and replayed last batch; consumer produced the same event with new event_id but preserved request_id in payload. Also a later lambda re-emitted an event after a DLQ retry, but the re-emitted event had request_uuid field instead of request_id. Our loader treats missing request_id as separate request => duplicates.
olivia_billing: so root cause is mismatch in dedupe key when re-emitting? customers get billed for each event row since billing sums unit_count.
sam_product: priority P1 for fix, customer impacted. What's the shortest rollback or patch?
vikram_eng-ml: quick patch: alter the aggregator to dedupe on COALESCE(request_id, request_uuid) and ignore events older than 5m when a matching request_id exists. I'll open a hotfix.
metrics-bot: [deploy] metrics-aggregator hotfix (dedupe-coalesce) queued, reviewers: vikram_eng-ml, sam_product.
vikram_eng-ml: patch applied to staging, backfilled test: re-ran query -> raw_events=9, distinct_coalesced=3, sum_units=3600, but billing_aware_units=1200 (we compute billing by distinct_coalesced * avg). Need to run fix in prod and run a backfill to correct aggregated metric.
maria_support: I told customer we're investigating and will rollback any overcharges. They replied: "Thanks — this is affecting our month-end billing, please escalate."
olivia_billing: I'll prepare a billing credit calc. For this customer looks like 2400 extra units in the window (3600-1200). I'll draft a credit.
vikram_eng-ml: deploying hotfix to prod now. ETA 7 minutes. After deploy we'll run backfill script:
```bash
# backfill aggregates for range
python tools/backfill_aggregates.py --start '2026-04-12T01:00:00Z' --end '2026-04-12T02:00:00Z' --dedupe-key 'coalesce(request_id, request_uuid)'
```
metrics-bot: [deploy] metrics-aggregator hotfix deployed at 2026-04-12T01:29:10Z.
vikram_eng-ml: prod query after deploy: raw_events=9, coalesced_requests=3, billing_units=1200. backfill queued.
maria_support: updated customer: hotfix deployed, backfill + billing credit in progress. They replied :thumbsup: and asked for postmortem.
sam_product: let's schedule a short postmortem and add a test in our ingest e2e that asserts dedupe across both request_id/request_uuid fields. Also add a dashboard comparing raw_events vs distinct(coalesce(...)) to catch regression.
olivia_billing: will confirm credit and SLA notes.
vikram_eng-ml: root cause summary: re-emission path used request_uuid instead of request_id; aggregator used request_id dedupe only -> duplicates counted; fix: coalesce keys and backfill. Will open follow-up PR to standardize field names across re-emission code.
maria_support: marking thread resolved for now, will attach customer's final confirmation once credit posts.
